run_prepare_coco_stuff_sem_seg: run the script to convert COCO-Stuff 10k annotations from .mat to PNG format for detectron2
run_dataset_conversion_train_test: run the script to process both train and test splits of COCO-Stuff 10k dataset
run_mat_to_png_conversion: run the script to convert HDF5 .mat annotation files to PNG semantic segmentation masks
run_copy_images_detectron2: run the script to copy COCO-Stuff images into a detectron2-compatible directory structure
run_label_remapping: run the script to remap COCO-Stuff labels by subtracting 2 so ignore class becomes 255
